sql:
WITH order_values AS (
  SELECT
    o.orderid,
    (
      COALESCE(o.comments, '') ~* '(promo|discount|coupon|black friday)'
      OR COALESCE(o.internalcomments, '') ~* '(promo|discount|coupon|black friday)'
      OR COALESCE(o.deliveryinstructions, '') ~* '(promo|discount|coupon|black friday)'
      OR BOOL_OR(COALESCE(ol.description, '') ~* '(promo|discount|coupon|black friday)')
    ) AS has_promotion,
    SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unitprice) AS order_value
  FROM wideworldimporters.sales.orders o
  JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.orderlines ol ON ol.orderid = o.orderid
  WHERE CAST(o.orderdate AS DATE) = DATE '2024-11-29'
  GROUP BY o.orderid, o.comments, o.internalcomments, o.deliveryinstructions
)
SELECT
  has_promotion,
  COUNT(*) AS order_count,
  AVG(order_value) AS average_order_value
FROM order_values
GROUP BY has_promotion
ORDER BY has_promotion DESC
LIMIT 500
proposed:

      OR COALESCE(o.deliveryinstructions, '') ~* '(promo|discount|coupon|black friday)'
      OR BOOL_OR(COALESCE(ol.description, '') ~* '(promo|discount|coupon|black friday)')

    SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unitprice) AS order_value
  FROM wideworldimporters.sales.orders o
  JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.orderlines ol ON ol.orderid = o.orderid
  WHERE CAST(o.orderdate AS DATE) = DATE '2024-11-29'

FROM order_values
GROUP BY has_promotion

FROM wideworldimporters.sales.orderlines ol
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.orders o ON ol.orderid = o.orderid
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.customers c ON o.customerid = c.customerid
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.specialdeals sd ON (sd.stockitemid IS NULL OR sd.stockitemid = ol.stockitemid)
  AND (sd.customerid = c.customerid OR sd.buyinggroupid = c.buyinggroupid OR sd.customercategoryid = c.customercategoryid)
  AND o.orderdate BETWEEN sd.startdate AND sd.enddate
ORDER BY o.orderid, ol.orderlineid, sd.specialdealid
LIMIT 500

FROM wideworldimporters.sales.orderlines ol
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.orders o ON ol.orderid = o.orderid
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.customers c ON o.customerid = c.customerid
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.specialdeals sd ON (sd.stockitemid IS NULL OR sd.stockitemid = ol.stockitemid)
  AND (sd.customerid = c.customerid OR sd.buyinggroupid = c.buyinggroupid OR sd.customercategoryid = c.customercategoryid)
